name: Nils Ušakovs, Michalis Hadjipantela - Après le § 24 - Am 40
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2027
part_text: 24b. Urges the Commission and the Member States to present a critical audit of current defence expenditure within the Union, detailing why European countries would be unable to defend themselves with budgets vastly superior to those of most of the world’s countries;
